name: Chip
label: Chip
description: Compact pills for attributes, filters, and inline metadata.

props.name: label
props.description: Chip label — string for plain text, ReactNode for richer content (e.g. a numbered prefix)

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode)

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state (filter-style chips): renders the active fill, coloured by `tone`

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour of the selected fill: `default` takes the action colour, `neutral`
fills it grey, for filter rows whose selection should read quietly.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip size — `large` matches the default Button and paragraph body scale, for pills that are a primary tap target rather than metadata

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click handler — presence makes the chip an interactive <button>. On a
removable chip it is attached to the main region's button rather than
the root span.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove handler — renders a trailing close button (input-style chips)

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Accessible label for the remove button. Defaults to "Remove". Pass a
function to name each chip's button after its own label, so a row of
chips does not announce one name for every button: it is given the
label's text (a rich label's text content), e.g.
`(label) => \`Remove ${label}\``. A plain string is used as given.
